family: 日本融合教学行为自评 / Fukasawa–Kawamura 2020

scoringContract.nativePlan: existing generic SUM scorer; no new engine
scoringContract.originalWhole12Total: Supported by original paper; only from original whole instrument, never a sum across tools or repeated child administrations.
scoringContract.missing: Paper excluded incomplete teacher records; no validated partial-score imputation provided. Planned complete_required is a conservative project rule, not an author missing-data manual.
scoringContract.anchors: Exact Japanese labels read in methods; not reproduced here. Lowest choice expresses an intention conditional on available capacity rather than never doing the behavior.

optionalComposite.policy: Choose original full12 once or selected child scales; avoid duplicate items. Composite has no new aggregate total.

unscoredFormCandidates.scope: Original factual background/experience/training questions, optional after permission and relevance/privacy review; no scoring report

translation: No Chinese item translation created; future translation uses distinct identity/version.
